node.title: HGE4 primitive shift-pair near-square union router
node.statement: An unordered primitive top shift pair is equivalent to a 2h-subset U whose locator D_U has the unique form S_U^2-d_U^2 with S_U monic of degree h and d_U a nonzero field element; the two signs reconstruct the pair. If V_free,V_swap count free and antipodal-swap scaling orbits of valid primitive unions, then O_h^prim=2V_free+V_swap. Distinct valid unions containing 1 satisfy A_h^union=hO_h^prim, so sum_h A_h^union/h<=14n^2 is exactly the HGE4 orbit target. The anchored candidate space falls by binom(2h-1,h-1) compared with ordered disjoint-pair enumeration. The aggregate count remains open.
